packet-02 - unverified image reading (blind; no identification seen in context)

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001.jpg, reduced overview)
- Observation: this is PRINTED text (roman type, early modern), not manuscript. One paper leaf/sheet fragment, landscape, held by four plastic weights; colour checker lower left, scale right. Pencil shelfmark-like note on the substrate between the pages: "Stams, StA, Frag. 223-1r" (?).
- Two page-areas side by side, one text column each (single-column pages), separated by a blank gutter area:
  - Left page: running head "470  QVAESTIO XXXVI." (page number 470 at left).
  - Right page: running head "QVAESTIO XXXVI.  467" (page number 467 at right).
  - Page numbers 470 and 467 not consecutive: tentatively part of a folded printed sheet (imposition), not an opening.
- Right page has signature "Nnn 2" at foot and catchword "nostrae". A marginal number "26" in left margin of right page beside line "admittantur: nam regulariter..." (tentatively a paragraph/numbered-section marker).
- Left page: ca. 32 lines; foot ends "...de do- / nat. In-" (catchword-like). Left margin of left page lost/damaged; first letters of many lines missing or stained.
- Content looks like Latin legal prose with allegations (citations "l." "c." "§." "nu." "conf."), i.e. text with embedded citation chains; no glosses or rubrics visible. No enlarged initials visible.
- Damage: brown staining, losses along left edge and bottom; upper margin trimmed.
